gloss: to compensate for; to supplement; to make up for

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {補|おぎな}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to compensate for; to make up for
definitions.explanation: To offset or counterbalance a deficiency or loss.
To add what is lacking or needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う。
⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{補|おぎな}った。
examples.english: I made up for my lack of experience with hard work.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}い⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧。
examples.english: A relationship where we compensate for each other's weaknesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{損失|そんしつ}→損失：04875_sonshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}った。
examples.english: The loss was compensated for by insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drank a lot of water to replenish my fluids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{補|おぎな}う。
examples.english: We are short-staffed, so we will supplement with part-time workers.

notes:
{補|おぎな}う is transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). It takes を for what is being supplemented or made up for.

ASPECT (ている):
{補|おぎな}っている indicates ongoing compensation or supplementation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う (to supplement nutrition)
- ⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う (to make up for a shortage)
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補|おぎな}う (to compensate for weaknesses)
- {補|おぎな}い⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to complement each other)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～を{補|おぎな}う: What is being supplemented/compensated
- ～で{補|おぎな}う: What is used to compensate

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧: Supplement, addition
- ⟦{補充|ほじゅう}→補充：14037_hojuu⟧: Replenishment
- ⟦{補償|ほしょう}→補償：03720_hoshou⟧: Compensation (financial)
